title: Power Pages: enhanced authorisation maps web roles and site users to Dataverse security
notes: claim 38: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
2026-11-16: taken offline; the grace for pages published before the check existed is off
summary: Hold: the auditing claim omits the requirement to enable auditing on the Dataverse tables, and the control path substitutes a descriptive phrase for the documented Edit button. Licensing and the core authorization model are supported, but the assurance that visitors see no change is not documented.

claims.claim: Dataverse evaluates permissions directly and returns only records permitted by the site user's roles.
